reference: Momma asase nyinaa nyɛ komm wɔ nʼanim.
hypothesis: Wɔn asase nyinaa yɛ kɔn mu wɔ n’anim.

reference: Enti mede gram ɔha aduoson baako ne atoko lita ɔha aduɔwɔtwe abien ne atoko lita aduɔkron baako kɔpataa no.
hypothesis: Ntomirigam ɔha aduosan baako. Ne atoku lieta ɔha adua watwa ebien. Ne atoku lieta aduɔ korɔ baako ɔpataa no.

reference: Ɔde me asi nʼani so; nʼagyantowfo atwa me ho ahyia.
hypothesis: Ɔdomea si n'ani so. N'adiantofo atwa mehu ahyia.

reference: nea ofi Bosra a nkekae kɔkɔɔ wɔ nʼatade mu yi?
hypothesis: Nia ɔfiri bosir a nkeka kɔkɔɔ wɔ n'ataade mu yie.

reference: Onyankopɔn nam ne tumi so twe atumfo kɔ; ɛwɔ mu sɛ wonya asetena pa de, nanso wonni nkwa ho bɔhyɛ.
hypothesis: Nyakopɔ nnam no ntoma so twe atumfokuo. Wɔn mu sɛ wɔn nyinaa asɛte n'apadi. Nanso wɔn ani nkɔ ho bɔhyɛ.

reference: ɔno na ɔbɛboa wo: Nsuro Yakob, me somfo.
hypothesis: Ɔno na ɔbɛboa wɔ. Nsuo yɛ akɔ mmesuonfoɔ.

reference: Mobɛhwehwɛ me nanso morenhu me, efisɛ faako a merekɔ no morentumi nkɔ hɔ.
hypothesis: Nwoma hwehwɛɛm, n'aso mmurihu mu. Ebisɛ faako a mmere kɔ no, worutu minkɔ ho.

reference: Hwehwɛ ɔkwan a wobɛfa so, nanso wɔbɛsɛe no; da wo nsusuwii adi, nanso ɛrennyina.
hypothesis: Hwehwɛɔkwan a ɔbɛfa so na nso ɔbɛsɛe no. Da wɔnsusu wiadi na nso ɛre nyinaa.

reference: Ɛrenkyɛ koraa, wɔrennan Lebanon nyɛ no asasebere.
hypothesis: Owabue asi, mmienu ma kɛnkɛn. Awuradze kase, saa nnipa yi de anohunu.

reference: Moafa mʼanyame nyinaa ne me sɔfo, na minni hwee bio!
hypothesis: Mmɔframma anyinam nyinaa nam sɔfo, na mmenyin hwee bi hɔ. Dan mmarima no bi a ɛsi. Hwɛn a wɔreka no yie.

reference: Gideon buae se, “Na Awurade, mɛyɛ dɛn agye Israelfo?
hypothesis: Gidu mboa asi, na wura ade. Mmarina no gyina ezraefo.

reference: Ennya nnuu twabere, a nhwiren bere atwam no.
hypothesis: Anyinwa anu twa berɛ a nhwiren berɛ atwa mu no.

reference: Enti Filistifo ntuanofo no de agyan so ahama ason a ɛnwoe brɛɛ Delila ma ɔde kyekyeree Samson.
hypothesis: Ndifoosifo ntoano fo di agya no ahahamma ason a ɛho yɛ brɛ de laela ma ɔde kyerɛkyerɛ santsen.

reference: Akyiri no, Delila ka kyerɛɛ no se, “Wudii me ho fɛw, twaa me nkontompo.
hypothesis: Ɛkyere no, line a kakra no si wɔdi mmɛhofoɔ atwa mɛnkotɔn bo, ɛfɛ mmesra wɔ kyerɛ mmesane a wɔbɛtumi akyekyere wɔ papa yi. Samson boa no si sɛ wɔde ntampem. Hama a wɔwɔ mfɛn no dwuma biara da akyekyere noa.

reference: Afei ɔforo kɔɔ Awurade asɔredan no mu kɔtrɛw mu wɔ Awurade anim.
hypothesis: Afirafoɔ rekɔ wɔ awuradeɛ asɔredan no mu. Kɔtere a wɔwɔ awuradeɛ no mu.

reference: Nanso Awurade yɛ onyansafo a obetumi de ɔhaw aba; ɔnsesa nʼano.
hypothesis: Nanso awurade yɛ onyansafoɔ a wɔrebɛtumi de ɔhawaba. Ɔresesa no ano.

reference: Melkisedek nyɛ Lewi aseni, nanso ogyee nkyɛmu du mu baako fii Abraham nkyɛn hyiraa no ma onyaa Onyankopɔn bɔhyɛ no.
hypothesis: Mmaakyi sɛdɛkanea awe ase ni. Na nso ogya nkyemu dumu baako fi abrɛ a wɔn nkyɛn hyɛn ano. Na onya onya kɔpɔnbɔ hyɛ no.

reference: So ɛnsɛ sɛ mo ne wɔn a ɔkɔm de wɔn kyɛ mo aduan.
hypothesis: Nyɛresa a ɛmu ne wɔn a ɔkɔm de wɔn tɛm aduan.

reference: ɔde atɛntrenee besi gyinae ama asase so ahiafo.
hypothesis: Ɔde atɛntene ne bɛsi gyina ama asase so ɛhiafo.

reference: Saa ntam yi nti, Yesu gyina mu ma yɛn, na ɛma yɛne Onyankopɔn apam no di mu.
hypothesis: Santa mente yɛso gya mu ma yɛn. Nneɛma yɛde nyɛnko pɔn apɔn no demo.

reference: Wɔde kurow no too Dan a ɔyɛ wɔn tete agya Israel no ba, na kan no wɔfrɛ hɔ Lais.
hypothesis: Wɔde kuro no toɔ dan a ɔyɛ wɔn tete agyae dza ano ba. Na kan no wɔfrɛ hɔ laes.

reference: ” Na Abraham nim sɛ Onyankopɔn betumi anyan awufo afi owu mu, na ɔkwan bi so no, yebetumi aka se Onyankopɔn nyan Isak fii owu mu.
hypothesis: Abrɛn ne mfeɛ a wɔn nyawopɔn bi ɛtwin nyɛn afufu afi wɔn mu. Na ɔkwan bi so no, yɛtwin akɛse. Wɔn nyawopɔn nyɛn no, ɛsakɛseɛ wɔ wɔn mu.

reference: Efi atɔe fam, nnipa besuro Awurade din.
hypothesis: Efi atɔe fam. Nnipa bɛsoro ɛwɔ adidini.

reference: Na ɛsow aba pa a efi aba a asomdwoefo duaa no asomdwoe mu no mu.
hypothesis: Ɛsoa bɛpa a ɛfi aba a asombriefo dua no asombriefo no mu.

reference: Mmom, wofifi wɔn nkurow mu boaa wɔn ho ano wɔ Gibea sɛ wɔne Israelfo no rebɛko.
hypothesis: Mbom, wɔfifi wɔn kurom aboa a wɔn ho ano wɔ ebi ase. Wɔn no adidrafo no reba kɔ .

reference: sɛnea wɔrekɔ no ɛbɛma wɔapini wɔn akyi; wobepirapira, na wɔatɔ afiri mu, na wɔakyere wɔn.
hypothesis: Sinni a wɔrekɔ no, ɛbɛma waapiri wɔn akyi. Obi apirapira na wɔato afiri mu na wɔakyerɛ wɔn.

reference: Yesu maa ne mu so no, obisaa ɔbea no se, “Nnipa a wɔde wo bae no wɔ he?
hypothesis: Yusu ma anim so no, basaw bea no si. Nnipa a wɔde ɛwɔ baa no wɔhen.

reference: Sɛɛ na Awurade ka kyerɛ me: “Sɛnea gyata woro so.
hypothesis: Saa na ɛwɔ ade kakra mu, sɛdeɛ ɛgyata wɔ ɛsoro.

reference: “Mo anyansafo, muntie me nsɛm; mo nimdefo monyɛ aso mma me.
hypothesis: Wɔn nyansafo, wɔn ti amansam. Wɔn anim de fam, wɔn nyansosoma no.

reference: ebefi nnipa a wɔwoware na wɔn honam yɛ trontrom hɔ.
hypothesis: Ɛda fi nnipa a wɔwɔ wɔn adeɛ a wɔn ahu nam yɛ tuntum hɔ.

reference: Ankyɛ, ɔhene Sanaherib nyaa nkra se, Tirhaka Etiopiani a ɔyɛ Misraimhene di asraafo anim rebɛko atia no.
hypothesis: Dankyɛ, ɔhene sɛn a haire panyin a nkrase. Tseɛ haka tuo piɛni a ɔyɛ mmeyia a ɔhene di asraafoɔ anim rebaako atua no.

reference: anaa waka ato hɔ, sɛnea yebetumi aka se, ‘Ne de no ye’?
hypothesis: Anaa waka atɔ hɔ, sɛnea yi bɛtumi akɛse na ɛdi no yie.

reference: Awurade ne nʼakode a ɛyɛ nʼabufuwhyew; bɛsɛe ɔman no nyinaa.
hypothesis: Awurante ne n'akode a ɛyɛ n'abofu hyew bɛhyɛ ɔman no nyinaa.

reference: “Ka eyi kyerɛ wɔn: ‘Saa anyame a ɛnyɛ wɔn na wɔyɛɛ ɔsoro ne asase no bɛyera afi asase so ne ɔsorosoro ase.
hypothesis: Nnipa ɛyi kyerɛ wɔn. Saa anyame anya wɔn na wɔyɛ ɔsoro ne asase no bɛyiri afi asase so ne ɔsorosoro ase.

reference: Ɔne Isak ne Yakob a Onyankopɔn hyɛɛ wɔn bɔ koro no ara bi tenaa ntamadan mu.
hypothesis: Wɔn a wɔsa kanea kɔpa a wɔnyea kɔpa ahyia wɔn mbɔkoro no ara bi gyina ntama dan mu.

reference: Saa da no, Misraimfo bɛyɛ sɛ mmea, Asafo Awurade nsa a wama so atia wɔn no bɛma wɔn abɔ hu na wɔn ho apopo.
hypothesis: Asaada no, mesiafo bɛyɛ sɛ mmea. Asafoɔ wura ne nsa a wɔama so atia wɔn no bɛma wɔn abɔ mu, na wɔn ho apɔpɔ.

reference: Ampa ara asupɔw no ani da me so; Tarsis ahyɛn na wodi anim.
hypothesis: Ampaara, asupɔ no ɛne dame so. Tases ahyɛn na wɔadi anim.

reference: Sɛ wɔn nhyɛsofo nti wosu frɛ Awurade a, ɔbɛsoma ogyefo ne bammɔni, na obegye wɔn.
hypothesis: Tseɛ wɔn hyɛ sukuu nti wɔn so fra wura adeɛ a ɔba so ma ogyafo ne bambɔni na ɔbɛgye wɔn.

reference: Ɔno nso buae se, “Meyɛ Lewini a mifi Betlehem wɔ Yuda na merehwehwɛ baabi atena.
hypothesis: Ɔno nso boa si. Mmienu a wɔn ani afi bɛtere hɛn wɔn awida nam rehwehwɛ baabi atena. Nika kakra no si. Wɔn mmerantena ha.

reference: Ɔbabea Babilonia; tena fam na mfa ahengua.
hypothesis: Ɔbaa bi ababolo nea, tena fam na mfa hɔn wa.

reference: “Nanso obiara nni hɔ ka ne ho, na hena na obetumi atia no?
hypothesis: N'ahosuo bi ɛne hɔ ka ne ho. Ɛha no bɛtumi atia no.

reference: Yɛn mu bi bo nkyɛ fuw, anhwɛ a wɔn bo befuw na wɔakum wo ne wʼabusuafo.
hypothesis: Yamu bi bɔ nkyɛnfo, ahwɛ a wɔabɔ bɛfu na wɔakum wɔn na wɔabɔsuafo.

reference: Ankyɛ na kurowmma no tee sɛ Samson wɔ hɔ, enti Gasa mmarima boaboaa wɔn ho ano na wɔtwɛn kurow no pon ano anadwo mu no nyinaa.
hypothesis: Ankyɛ na kuroma no te sɛ santsen wɔ hɔ. Nti gaasa mmarima abobɔboa wɔn ho ano na wɔtwe nkuro no pɔnga ano a no dwam no nyinaa.

reference: Nnipa bue wɔn ano di me ho fɛw; wɔbɔ me sotɔre de bu me animtiaa.
hypothesis: Nnipa bi wɔn ano de mu ho fɛw. Wɔabɔ nsotɔɔre de bu mmienu tea.

reference: Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me se, “Fa nhoma mmobɔwee kɛse no na fa kyerɛwdua biara kyerɛw so.
hypothesis: Adwadeka kyerɛ me si. Fa ahoma mmobɔ kɛse no na fa kyerɛ dua biara kyerɛ wɔ soro.

reference: Israelhene ne Ogyefo, Asafo Awurade se: Mene odikanfo ne okyikafo; Onyankopɔn biara nni hɔ sɛ me.
hypothesis: Zera a ɛhene ne ɔgyefo, asafoɔ a wɔwɔ adesie. M'ani wɔde kanfo na ɔkyi kɔforo. Nyɛnko pɔnkɔ biara a ɛni hɔ sɛ mma .

reference: Bere a Onyankopɔn kaa ntam se, “Wɔremma me home mu da” no, na ɔreka akyerɛ ɛhefo?
hypothesis: Bere a ɔnye akɔpɔnka ntam si wɔre maame hu mu mu dan no na ɔreka kyerɛ ɛhɛnfo.

reference: mede mʼanom nsɛm kunkum mo; mʼatemmu baa mo so sɛ anyinam.
hypothesis: Bedumayɛ no mu sɛm kɔnkɔn mu. Maame mu baa a ɔso sɛ anyinam.

reference: Mʼahɔho ne me mmaawa bu me sɛ ɔhɔho; mete sɛ ɔnanani ma wɔn.
hypothesis: Mmaa ahohoro ne mmarima a wɔabɔ mu nso wɔ hɔ hɔ. Metu hyɛ ɔne n'anim a wɔn .

reference: Na Sisera wɔ nnade nteaseɛnam ahankron, na ɔde atirimɔden hyɛɛ Israelfo no so mfirihyia aduonu.
hypothesis: N'ahyehyɛ no a wɔn adeɛ nte aseɛ nam ahan korɔ. Na ɔde ɛkyerɛ no, ɔde nhyɛes rafɔ no so mfirihyɛ duonu.

reference: Enti wobisae se, “Bere a yɛde yɛn ho kyerɛɛ Awurade wɔ Mispa no na obi nni hɔ bi ana?
hypothesis: Ntiwabi saa ɛsi praeɛ de yɛn ho kyerɛ a yɛwɔ ade wɔ mbispa no na obi nni ho bi anaa.

reference: Ɔsɔre anɔpahema bɔ ɔhyew afɔre ma wɔn mu biara, efisɛ na osusuw sɛ, “Ebia na me mma no ayɛ bɔne na wɔadome Onyankopɔn wɔ wɔn koma mu.
hypothesis: Ɔsraa nnɔpahama abɔ ahyia fam a wɔn mu biara. Mfidie no sisi wɔ sɛ ebien a ne mma no ayɛ borɔne na wɔadum anya nkɔpa wɔ wɔn kɔn mu.
